fixed_source_references.observation: Native selected owner composes the maintained TF runtime service; runtime branch explicitly supplies FILE_EXT WAV.
Native TF service still instantiates the DDR file path.
Selected file reader hardcodes FAST divider12 at50MHz.
True no-DDR reference uses2048 byte prefill and4096 byte FIFO.
Existing reference reserves640 bytes before accepting one512-byte sector.
Successful IDLE session changes state to READING; only the subsequent READING session returns done.
Only data from READING session is forwarded.
Every SPI session includes255 byte-times of trailing wait.
Trailing wait disables sck but still decrements on the SPI byte timebase.
Effective divider is8bit and clamps values below2; sector FAST0 selects init divider.
Token window is40000 SPI bytes, so its wall time decreases when SPI speeds up.

fixed_source_references.anchor: end else begin   // read FAT to get next cluster
fixed_source_references.observation: Playback reads an entire FAT sector on each cluster transition, with no tagged cache.
Native analysis and playback are mutually exclusive; analysis readiness does not qualify playback acceptance.
Missing active TF frame increments TF_UNDERRUN and produces an explicit error zero frame without waiting for the source.
Old byte/FIFO end condition does not prove final physical I2S frame completion.

findings.conclusion: At the fixed commit the declared profile selects WAV and the native service still routes file bytes through capture4KiB, DDR DMA and playback4KiB before decoding. Direct command-buffer connection is still DDR-backed. The independent tf_sd_audio_pcm_player is a reusable no-DDR structural reference, not a native lifecycle drop-in.

The runtime selector replaces tf_audio_ddr_path with the maintained native path. SD/FAT, sector/session transport and direct-player inputs still equal their resource_rework_route0 locked objects. The fixed tree contains later owner changes than some profile locks; this audit does not prepare a candidate or verify its profile lock closure.

The historical control fixture observes2 completed identical CMD17 sessions for1 logical512-byte sector. A third one-source-clock start after req_hold clearing aborts before any data; it is not a third completed sector. Every full session also has255 byte-times trailing wait in the real session source.

The calculated old-transport upper bound ignores additional overhead. Even FAST2 yields at most347675B/s without FAT traffic, below both48k stereo32 input384000B/s and44.1k stereo32 input352800B/s. FAST12 cannot sustain either stereo16 mode; buffering alone cannot fix long-run throughput.

The fixed40000-byte token wait represents166.4ms atFAST12,89.6ms atFAST6,51.2ms atFAST3 and38.4ms atFAST2. A speed change must preserve the prior wall-time patience through an explicit native adaptation. The historical approximately100ms rationale is source/history-derived; no SD specification was revalidated in this audit.

Qualified healthy service must bound long-run throughput and maximum cumulative PCM deficit. The4/5sec reader watchdog is failure/recovery policy, not seamless playback reserve. Proposed50ms deficit and3072-frame prefill are unverified qualification targets. Source exhaustion must remain an observable underrun/failure while the audio schedule continues.

raw EOF, decoder drain, PCM queue drain, metadata bridge drain and final physical-frame ACK are distinct. Current pcm_end proves none of the final physical completion, so no EOF/drained success may be claimed from this audit.

Effective session divider is clamped to2 only when the supplied value is below2; otherwise only low8bits are stored. Parameters above255 truncate and have no range guard, so no supported high-speed behavior is inferred. New native adaptation must reject out-of-range values. FAST0 selects the init divider, FAST1 reaches effective2; legal native candidate range is2..255.

proposed_implementation_stages.action: Promote only necessary attributed/GPL native sector-control adaptations; retain original vendor/baseline bytes and before-source provenance. Remove repeated full CMD17 and bound legal trailing clock/CS handling, preserve real request/response semantics and wall-time token patience. Use existing source selection and explicit new candidate.

Test native FAST2 effective8.333MHz after transport correction; this is a candidate speed requiring IO/SD board qualification. A512-byte FAT sector cache with tag/valid/reset improves consecutive-chain lookups but cannot guarantee arbitrary fragmentation. Validate continuous-cluster descriptors from FAT; retain one transport owner.

Add a default-disabled native stream branch around the two byte FIFOs and DDR DMA, reuse the same reader/decoder and checked restart/hold lifecycle, tie file-path DDR request outputs inactive. Use a held-ready skid. Do not create another complete chain or numbered production builder.

Place a plain32bit PCM queue after decoder in50MHz source domain; keep metadata/generation CDC shallow. Separate format-ready from prefill-ready and release short files on verified end. Preserve pause exact position, external stop clear/mailbox barriers and discard all old-sector tails after cancellation.

The current owner selects playback inmode1 and analysis inmode0. Reusing direct ingress for both is the smallest option; analysis may backpressure only its own mode. Retaining DDR-backed analysis would require a larger explicit per-session branch choice after quiesce/restart, never a live combinational FIFO mux.

Record matching-client DDR accepted reads/writes=0, waveform/throughput bounds, both-rate full-format tests, default source preservation, same-configuration synthesis/P&R physical resource/timing/CDC, then separate board acceptance. Keep other DDR clients/address ownership and current candidate rollback; do not reallocate TF banks from this audit.
